files.html: //! pipeline_sampler - texture sampling control (`src/notes/webgpu_control.md`, Phase 3): one texture drawn four ways, //! each through its own sampler, with texture coordinates running from 0 to 2.5 so that both halves of a sampler show: //! //! nearest / repeat linear / repeat //! linear / clamp linear / mirror //! //! The FILTER decides how texels become pixels when the texture is magnified: nearest keeps every texel a hard square, //! linear blends the four texels around each pixel. The ADDRESS MODE decides what a coordinate past the edge (u or v //! above 1) reads: repeat starts the texture over, clamp holds the edge texel, mirror flips every other copy. //! //! The pattern - a checkerboard tinted by a gradient, red across and green down - is computed on the CPU and uploaded //! once (`patternPixels`). The 2D renderer draws the cells, so the example has no shader of its own and runs the same //! on the web and on Windows. Each cell is the one texture seen through a view of its own, paired with its own sampler: //! the 2D renderer keeps one material per texture view, so four samplers need four views. //! //! Build: zig build pipeline-sampler -Dplatform=web (or -Dplatform=windows) const std = @import("std"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const z = @import("zimr"); const common = @import("example_common"); const zm = @import("zm"); const Vec3 = zm.Vec3; const clamp01 = zm.clamp01; const float = zm.float; const lerp = zm.lerp; const vec3 = zm.vec3; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); /// The texture is this many texels on a side. const texture_size: u32 = 128; /// RGBA8: four bytes a texel. const pattern_bytes: usize = texture_size * texture_size * 4; /// The cells' texture coordinates run from 0 to this, so each cell shows the texture this many times across. const uv_max: f32 = 2.5; /// Checkerboard squares along each side of the texture. const checker_squares: f32 = 6; const dark: Vec3 = .{ 0.10, 0.12, 0.20 }; const light: Vec3 = .{ 0.96, 0.92, 0.80 }; /// How far the checkerboard is mixed toward the gradient. const tint_amount: f32 = 0.45; /// The gradient's blue, everywhere: its red runs with u and its green with v. const tint_blue: f32 = 0.55; /// Half a cell's side, in the layout's unit: half the window's smaller side. const cell_half_side: f32 = 0.42; /// One of the four ways of sampling the texture, and where it is drawn. const Cell = struct { /// The cell's centre, in the layout's unit from the window's centre, y up. center_x: f32, center_y: f32, label: []const u8, /// Linear filtering, magnifying and minifying, or nearest. is_linear: bool, address: z.wgpu.SamplerDesc.AddressMode, }; const cells = [4]Cell{ .{ .center_x = -0.52, .center_y = 0.52, .label = "nearest / repeat", .is_linear = false, .address = .repeat }, .{ .center_x = 0.52, .center_y = 0.52, .label = "linear / repeat", .is_linear = true, .address = .repeat }, .{ .center_x = -0.52, .center_y = -0.52, .label = "linear / clamp", .is_linear = true, .address = .clamp_to_edge }, .{ .center_x = 0.52, .center_y = -0.52, .label = "linear / mirror", .is_linear = true, .address = .mirror_repeat }, }; const State = struct { font: z.Font, /// The pattern, uploaded once. texture: z.wgpu.TextureHandle, /// One view of the texture per cell, each drawn with the sampler beside it. views: [cells.len]z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle, samplers: [cells.len]z.wgpu.SamplerHandle, }; /// The pattern as RGBA8 texels, row by row from the top: a checkerboard of `checker_squares` squares a side, dark and /// light, mixed `tint_amount` of the way toward a gradient that runs red left to right and green top to bottom. fn patternPixels(out_pixels: *[pattern_bytes]u8) void { for (0..texture_size) |row| { for (0..texture_size) |column| { const u: f32 = float(column) / float(texture_size); const v: f32 = float(row) / float(texture_size); const checker: f32 = @mod(@floor(u * checker_squares) + @floor(v * checker_squares), 2.0); const base: Vec3 = lerp(dark, light, checker); const tinted: Vec3 = clamp01(lerp(base, vec3(u, v, tint_blue), tint_amount)); const texel: usize = (row * texture_size + column) * 4; out_pixels[texel + 0] = @round(tinted[0] * 255.0); out_pixels[texel + 1] = @round(tinted[1] * 255.0); out_pixels[texel + 2] = @round(tinted[2] * 255.0); out_pixels[texel + 3] = 255; } } } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const pixels: *[pattern_bytes]u8 = try gpa.create([pattern_bytes]u8); defer gpa.destroy(pixels); patternPixels(pixels); // Loaded before any GPU object is made: nothing below can fail, so nothing needs undoing. const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 20); const texture: z.wgpu.TextureHandle = z.wgpu.createTexture(f.gpu.device, .{ .width = texture_size, .height = texture_size, .format = .rgba8_unorm, .usage = .{ .texture_binding = true, .copy_dst = true }, .label = "sampler pattern", }); z.wgpu.queueWriteTexture(f.gpu.queue, texture, texture_size, texture_size, texture_size * 4, pixels); var views: [cells.len]z.wgpu.TextureViewHandle = undefined; var samplers: [cells.len]z.wgpu.SamplerHandle = undefined; for (cells, &views, &samplers) |cell, *view, *sampler| { view.* = z.wgpu.createTextureView(texture); sampler.* = z.wgpu.createSampler(f.gpu.device, .{ .mag_filter_linear = cell.is_linear, .min_filter_linear = cell.is_linear, .address_mode = cell.address, }); } s.* = .{ .font = font, .texture = texture, .views = views, .samplers = samplers, }; } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { for (s.views, s.samplers) |view, sampler| { z.wgpu.destroyTextureView(view); z.wgpu.destroySampler(sampler); } z.wgpu.destroyTexture(s.texture); z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { z.beginDrawing(f.gl); const width: f32 = f.window.widthf(); const height: f32 = f.window.heightf(); // The layout's unit, half the window's smaller side, keeps the cells square at any aspect. const unit: f32 = 0.5 * @min(width, height); const window_center_x: f32 = 0.5 * width; const window_center_y: f32 = 0.5 * height; const cell_side: f32 = 2 * cell_half_side * unit; // In texels, as `source` always is: `uv_max` times the texture's size runs the coordinates from 0 to `uv_max`. const source_side: f32 = uv_max * float(texture_size); const source: z.Rectangle = .{ .x = 0, .y = 0, .width = source_side, .height = source_side }; for (cells, s.views, s.samplers) |cell, view, sampler| { const left: f32 = window_center_x + (cell.center_x - cell_half_side) * unit; const top: f32 = window_center_y - (cell.center_y + cell_half_side) * unit; const drawable: z.WgpuTexture = .{ .handle = s.texture, .view = view, .sampler = sampler, .width = texture_size, .height = texture_size, }; const cell_rect: z.Rectangle = .{ .x = left, .y = top, .width = cell_side, .height = cell_side }; f.gl.texture(cell_rect, drawable, .{ .source = source }); // Under the cell, roughly centred. const label_x: f32 = window_center_x + cell.center_x * unit - 70; const label_y: f32 = window_center_y - (cell.center_y - cell_half_side) * unit + 8; f.gl.text(.{ label_x, label_y }, cell.label, .{ .size = 20, .color = common.palette.ink_dim, .font = &s.font, }); } common.caption(f.gl, s.font, "pipeline_sampler: filter (nearest/linear) + address (repeat/clamp/mirror)"); z.endDrawing(f.gl); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - WebGPU - pipeline sampler", .width = 800, .height = 600, .scale_mode = .responsive, .clear = .{ .r = 0.02, .g = 0.02, .b = 0.03, .a = 1.0 }, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, .manages_own_frame = true, };
